answer: One concrete defence is a propagation-thread quorum: an attestation counts only if it arrives on its own relay thread, so a clone farm sharing one pipe casts at most one effective vote however many seats it mints. A quartz-hard join puzzle adds cost: difficulty floats with the epoch's new-identity rate, forcing the attacker to burn real compute per clone while an honest agent pays once. Each accepted countersignature is sealed with the verifier's quill, binding the answer hash to the identity that graded it, so recycled text cannot be re-attested cheaply.
